Message.Name: Login Request Message
Message.Description: Used by the client to login to the Replay or Snapshot channel.

Field.Name: Username
Field.Description: CompID assigned to the client.

Field.Name: Password
Field.Description: Password assigned to the CompID.

Message.Name: Login Response Message
Message.Description: Used by the server to accept or reject a login request to the Replay or Snapshot channel.

Field.Name: Login Status
Field.Description: Status of the login request. The document names this field Status.

Message.Name: Snapshot Request Message
Message.Description: Used by the client to request for a snapshot of the current order book on the Snapshot channel.

Field.Name: Sequence Number
Field.Description: Sequence number from which client can build the order book.

Field.Name: Segment
Field.Description: Segment the request relates to. The field should contain only spaces if it does not relate to a segment.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Instrument the request relates to. The field should contain only spaces if it does not relate to an instrument. This field is ignored if Segment is specified.

Field.Name: Sub Book Flags
Field.Description: Order books the request relates to. The document names this field Sub Book.

Field.Name: Snapshot Type
Field.Description: Type of snapshot being requested.

Field.Name: Recover From Time
Field.Description: Sending time of the last processed trade with regards to Trades (3), or of the last received announcement with regards to News (5), in local time for the server (i.e. not UTC). Ignored if the Snapshot Type is not Trades (3) or News (5).

Field.Name: Request ID
Field.Description: Optional identifier of the request.

Message.Name: Snapshot Response Message
Message.Description: Used by the server to respond to a snapshot request on the Snapshot channel.

Field.Name: Sequence Number
Field.Description: Sequence number with which the snapshot is synchronised. This will be zero if Status is not "A". Ignore if Snapshot Type is not Order Book (0).

Field.Name: Order Count
Field.Description: Number of orders that will be transmitted in the snapshot. This will be zero if Order Book is empty or Status is not "A". Ignore if Snapshot Type is not Order Book (0).

Field.Name: Snapshot Status
Field.Description: Status of the snapshot request. The document names this field Status.

Field.Name: Snapshot Type
Field.Description: Type of snapshot.

Field.Name: Request ID
Field.Description: Identifier, if any, of Snapshot Request.

Message.Name: Snapshot Complete Message
Message.Description: Used by the server to indicate that the transmission of an order book snapshot is complete.

Field.Name: Sequence Number
Field.Description: Sequence number with which the snapshot is synchronised.

Field.Name: Segment
Field.Description: Segment the snapshot relates to. The field will contain only spaces if it does not relate to a segment.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Instrument the snapshot relates to. The field will contain only spaces if it does not relate to an instrument.

Field.Name: Sub Book Flags
Field.Description: Order books the snapshot relates to. The document names this field Sub Book.

Field.Name: Trading Status
Field.Description: Only indicated if the message is sent as a book level complete and the Snapshot Type is Order Book (0) or Statistics (4).

Field.Name: Snapshot Type
Field.Description: Type of snapshot.

Field.Name: Request ID
Field.Description: Identifier, if any, of Snapshot Request.

Message.Name: Logout Request Message
Message.Description: Used by the client to logout of the Replay or Snapshot channel.

Value.Name: Segment Symbol Or Sub Book Invalid Or Not Specified
